title: Video accounts
intro: Let Ronde create a lasting Zoom, Google Meet or Teams room for each meeting, with one account of the workspace. Nobody has to sign in.
name: Name
tokenKept: A secret is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
removeConfirm: Remove {name}? Rooms already created keep working.

secret.meet: Private key of the service account

hints.zoom: In the Zoom App Marketplace, create a “Server-to-Server OAuth” app with the scope meeting:write:meeting:admin, then copy its account ID, client ID and secret.
hints.meet: In Google Cloud, create a service account, give it domain-wide delegation for the scope meetings.space.created in the Google Workspace admin console, then paste the private_key of its JSON key.
hints.teams: In Microsoft Entra, register an application with the OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite.All application permission (admin consent) and an application access policy for the organizer.

useIt: Then, in the settings of a meeting, General → Video call: “Create a lasting room”.
